overview: The Praesertum Forum is the highest seat of Akhevan authority, where decrees are issued and civic doctrine is shaped.
history: Founded during the earliest Akhevan era to centralize governance.
Decree spires were added to amplify void‑arcane resonance during proclamations.
Council chambers expanded to support ritual‑aligned political deliberation.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Forum as the supreme civic institution.
Modern Forum remains the most symbolically powerful site in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A major Praesertum decree is about to be announced.
A decree spire destabilizes during resonance alignment.
A council chamber experiences void‑arcane interference.
A political faction attempts to influence Forum proceedings.
